John Danaher - collection 480p/Standing2.overview: John Danaher's no-gi takedown system for jiu-jitsu, ten volumes. Volume 1 covers the four most important ideas. Volume 2 covers nine hand-fighting principles and indirect gripping. Volume 3 is a special study of the snap down ('the jab of standing grappling'). Volumes 4 and 5 cover the double leg, including the elbow-deep double leg used by Georges St-Pierre. Volume 6 covers single leg finishes (kneeling and standing cutbacks). Volume 7 covers high leg finishes (de ashi harai, knee pressure). Volume 8 covers body lock takedowns. Volume 9 covers the knee pick (kuchiki daoshi). Volume 10 covers takedowns using the feet and legs (kouchi gari and others).
John Danaher - collection 480p/Standing2.for: No-gi jiu-jitsu players who want a complete takedown game.

John Danaher - collection 480p/Standing2.overview: John Danaher's upper body takedowns for submission grappling, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers upper body takedown concepts. Volume 2 is a special study of the cow catcher (a front headlock throw). Volume 3 covers uki waza (including arm drag and hip variations). Volume 4 covers sumi gaeshi (including whizzer and wrist against the single leg). Volume 5 covers throwing from the overhook (uki goshi and others). Volume 6 covers double overhooks. Volume 7 covers throwing from an underhook. Volume 8 covers upper body takedowns for older and less athletic grapplers.
John Danaher - collection 480p/Standing2.for: No-gi grapplers who prefer clinch work to shooting; older grapplers.

John Danaher - collection 480p/Train Saf.overview: A single video (about an hour) from John Danaher on training safely: how to look after your body and your training partners, avoid common injuries, and tap and train intelligently. No publisher listing was found for this title.
John Danaher - collection 480p/Train Saf.for: Everyone, especially older or injury-prone grapplers.
